Merely adapting could risk survival, as rising temperatures, water shortages, and severe air pollution threaten basic human needs. Though adaptation may seem practical, confronting climate change directly is essential. As more people experience its impacts firsthand, support for meaningful action is likely to grow.

topic: More and more companies are allowing employees to work at home. Do you think it is a positive or negative development?
essay:
It is obvious that nowadays most employers are giving working from home opportunities to their jobholders. In my view, it is a positive development. In this essay, I will explain my support by analysing how this chance save the time of both and helps talent to reach out to a great company without the boundary of physical barrier.

One of the most important merits of working from home is to be able to work more and spend less time on nonimportant things. This assist employee and employer to utilize that moment of preparing and riding. Additionally, if an engineer has to go to the office the preparation and commute to the location can be utilized to research the project. This would definitely help to increase productivity. Therefore, providing associate performing virtually has an affirmative effect on both parties' life.

Furthermore, many talented people, as well as organizations who are searching for matching skills and assignments out there, will get an opportunity to work for each other. There are many talents who can not come physically due to long-distance but has strong interest and knowledge in that particular field, which they would like to exercise virtually. For example, this facility resolves the problem of en-suit work such as using information technology many computer-related tasks can be completed without presenting at the destination.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that letting people finish their duty through a computer network is completely plus point which adds value to company and worker as well by keeping less second for the unproductive sector. Moreover, by doing so both of them will be able to find their best match a competent and intelligent manager for job provider and the best working environment for job seekers.

This increased efficiency benefits organizations as well, enabling them to identify and hire more qualified candidates regardless of location. Advances in technology allow skilled individuals to contribute remotely, breaking down geographical barriers between talent and opportunity. As a result, companies gain access to a broader talent pool, while employees enjoy work environments better suited to their needs, leading to mutually beneficial outcomes.

Companies can reduce overhead costs by downsizing physical office spaces.

Monitoring performance and maintaining accountability is more challenging remotely.
Isolation from coworkers can negatively impact employee morale and company culture.

structured_summary:
Major claim:
The government should strictly control the entry of immigrants to prevent future problems.

Claim 1:
Many people migrate to other countries for various reasons.
Premise: Individuals move abroad for work, education, or better living conditions.
Counterargument: None
Rebuttal: None

Claim 2:
Some governments have made immigration procedures more difficult, which upsets people who support free migration.
Premise: Certain countries impose strict relocation and immigration policies.
Premise: These restrictions create dissatisfaction among individuals who wish to migrate freely.
Counterargument: None
Rebuttal: None

Claim 3:
Immigration can provide economic and workforce benefits to host countries.
Premise: Immigrants can fill job positions in sectors suffering from labor shortages.
Premise: Some migrants move abroad to improve their professional knowledge and skills.
Premise: Skilled immigrants can contribute expertise in areas where specialists are lacking.
Premise: Citizens in some countries are unwilling to work in low-paid jobs.
Premise: Foreign workers, especially from poorer countries, are often willing to take these positions.
Claim: Immigration helps countries maintain labor-force balance.
Counterargument: None
Rebuttal: None

Claim 4:
Uncontrolled immigration may create social and security problems.
Premise: Some criminals flee to other countries to avoid punishment.
Premise: These individuals may continue criminal behavior after migration.
Premise: Differences in international laws can complicate arrest and deportation procedures.
Premise: International organizations such as Interpol help track international criminals.
Premise: Some immigrants may carry diseases that can spread in host countries.
Premise: Public health problems may increase government spending or contribute to pandemics.
Claim: Uncontrolled immigration can worsen conditions in the receiving country.
Counterargument: Immigration can also bring positive contributions through labor and expertise.
Rebuttal: None

Rebuttal: None
abstractive_summary: Governments should strictly regulate immigration to avoid future social, economic, and security challenges. While many people migrate for work, education, or better living conditions, and some countries benefit from immigrants filling labor shortages—especially in low-paid or specialized jobs—uncontrolled entry poses risks. Strict policies may upset advocates of free movement, but unchecked immigration can allow criminals to evade justice or introduce public health threats, straining resources and safety. Although immigrants contribute valuable skills and maintain workforce balance, unrestricted movement may lead to unpredictable consequences. Therefore, even with labor demands, governments must retain control over immigration to protect national stability and public welfare.

topic: Some people say that the experiences a child has before starting school have the most influence on their future life. Others say that experiences as a teenager, especially at school, are more influential. Discuss both views and give your own opinion?
essay:
Numerous characters deem memories from childhood, especially kindergarten memories, affects our future life; in contrast, certain groups of people oppose and affirm the future depends on the experiences from person's adolescence. From my perspective, I assume childhood memories form our habitual behaviour, while we gain knowledge and abilities.

On the one hand, it is an inevitable fact that we learn all skill and knowledge during the age of 13-19 and based on you what you learnt, your achievement and way of living form, which is why psychologists ask adolescence age before giving counsellings. Besides, every adult usually retrospects their young age-(13-19). For example, if we ask from a random man, do you remember your childhood? The man says not really, while the man vividly remembers his teenage age. Thus, memories of kindergartens do not affect adult life, since we do not even recall that period.

On the other hand, people putting importance on childhood are overlooking the fact that we do not gain enough information and develop ingenuity. If we recall our kindergarten age, we will realise we only learnt some basic skills. For instance, Rayleigh, a well-known psychologist from the USA, said in my view, I presume it is a futile method to probe my clients' childhood to treat the disorder. Hence, it is an undeniable fact that we learn to communicate, dress, eat, and other primary skills in our early life.

In conclusion, from the arguments and examples given, I firmly believe the idea that tender age is the root of our future, and people rejecting it will waste time and money.

Although children may lack advanced knowledge or creativity, these basic skills form the essential foundation for later development. Even if childhood memories fade and some psychologists downplay their relevance, the behavioral patterns established in these early years underpin future growth. Ignoring this foundational role risks inefficiency in fostering long-term success and well-being.

topic: Throughout the history, male leaders often made the society more violent and conflicting. If women governed the world, it would be more peaceful world. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give an example to support your idea.
essay:
It is often argued that women leadership in society may bring the most peaceable sense. While it is true for some major reasons, I agree that men could be an eligible chief in keeping world peace.

The decrease of international credence is caused by several national conflicts. Libya, Egypt and Syria are the notorious examples as Qhadafi, Asa'ad and Mubarak ways to conduct their country result on many terrible chaos. In this view, it seems to allow women who have leadership quality in endeavour peace to their county. Au San Suu Kyi, a political leader from Myanmar, has proved that woman has peaceful way to lead. Even though she is in powerful opposition in against military government who arrest her in unfair way in that era, she, further, could create stability around Myanmar in collaboration with the junta. Her steps, then, bestowed her as one of the peace Nobel Prize awardee.

However, women could prove illusory as the best leader from womanhood as they way of leading depict violence and hostility. Margaret Thatcher who ordered British Navy to conquer Falkland Island from Argentina is stance stronger as an obvious example. As results of this force, many victims died and the protest from world peace-lover around the world raised. Apart from the execrable example, history told Mahatma Gandhi as one of the inspiration in leading with peace. He leads in complex struggle to show his basic precepts Ahimsa, no violence, and Satyagraha, resistance from foreign helps. Gandhi proves that leading on against not always use weapon and bomb. Together with Suu Kyi, Gandhi success to become Nobel awardee and also become the symbol of peace.

In conclusion, although women might appropriate to become leader owing to their success in shunning violence, based on the historical fact, I believe that men are too capable to become peacekeeping leader.

Major claim:
Men are capable of being peacekeeping leaders.

Claim 1:
Some people believe that women leaders can create a more peaceful society.
Premise: International instability has been caused by conflicts in countries such as Libya, Egypt, and Syria.
Premise: The leadership of figures such as Gaddafi, Assad, and Mubarak contributed to social chaos and violence.
Premise: Aung San Suu Kyi demonstrated a peaceful leadership style in Myanmar.
Premise: Despite being unfairly imprisoned by the military government, she continued to pursue cooperation and stability.
Premise: Her peaceful political efforts earned her the Nobel Peace Prize.
Counterargument: None
Rebuttal: None

Claim 2:
Women are not always peaceful leaders.
Premise: Margaret Thatcher ordered military action during the Falklands War against Argentina.
Premise: The conflict caused many deaths.
Premise: The military action attracted criticism from peace supporters around the world.
Counterargument: Women are often considered more peaceful leaders.
Rebuttal: Historical examples show that female leaders can also use violence and military force.

Claim 3:
Men can also be symbols of peaceful leadership.
Premise: Mahatma Gandhi is widely regarded as an inspirational peaceful leader.
Premise: Gandhi promoted Ahimsa (nonviolence) and Satyagraha (peaceful resistance).
Premise: He demonstrated that leadership and resistance do not require weapons or violence.
Premise: Gandhi became an international symbol of peace.
Counterargument: Some argue that women are naturally more peaceful leaders.
Rebuttal: Gandhi’s example demonstrates that peaceful leadership is also achievable by men.

Claim 4:
Women may be suitable leaders because some have successfully avoided violence and promoted peace.
Premise: Female leaders such as Aung San Suu Kyi are associated with peaceful political movements.
Counterargument: None
Rebuttal: Historical evidence also shows peaceful male leaders and violent female leaders, so leadership style is not dependent on gender alone.
abstractive_summary: While some believe women are more inclined to peaceful leadership, exemplified by figures like Aung San Suu Kyi, who pursued stability and cooperation in Myanmar despite imprisonment and earned the Nobel Peace Prize, this view is not universally valid. Women such as Margaret Thatcher have led with military force, as seen in the Falklands War, which resulted in significant loss of life and drew global criticism. Conversely, men can embody peaceful leadership, as demonstrated by Mahatma Gandhi, whose commitment to nonviolence and civil resistance made him a global symbol of peace. Ultimately, leadership style is not determined by gender, as both men and women have shown capacity for both peace and violence.

Historical examples show women leaders who engaged in aggressive or expansionist policies.
Systemic political structures, not gender, primarily determine levels of conflict.

topic: The major cities in the world are growing fast, as well as their problems. What are the problems that young people living in cities are facing with? Give solutions to these problems.
essay:
Majority of the cities have been developing rapidly. This growing, leads to the problem that made the young people struggle. Nevertheless, there are some possible solutions that could be taken into account to address this issue.

High standard of living is a main problem of youngster living in the cities. All of the costs, such as foods and accommodations are higher than in the urban areas. This is due to the competition of business among city dwellers is firm. In addition, another major problem is the traffic jam. As the city is the most densely occupied area, many of them prefer using their own vehicle to using public transportation. Thus, it is undoubtedly that the bottleneck is the problem that make the youngster struggles.

Turning to the possible solutions, the young people ought to live economically and manage their money efficiently. For instance, they not buy unnecessary items, more often eat at home rather than at restaurant, and so forth. Therefore, they are able to save deposit for a rainy day. Another possible solution is, they are supposed to use public transportation in their daily pursuits. If the distance of destination place is nearby, walking is the best way to decrease the number of transportation in the street. Hence, the problems of traffic jam could be diminished.

In conclusion, living in the big cities leads to the troubles for the young people. However, the problems they facing are a challenge, in order to they become a good citizen who are able to adapt in every hard situation.

topic: The increase in the production of consumer goods results in damage to the natural environment. What are the causes of this? What can be done to solve this problem? eco-friendly world?
essay:
The increase of consumer goods has brought about a myriad of negative impacts on the natural environment. This essay will present the underlying cause and workable solutions to the problem.

Obviously, there is no denying that overpopulation is the root of the problem. With over 7 billion people around the world, the demands for basic necessities like food, clothes and shelters have been on the inexorable rise. As a result, rainforests have been cleared, especially in developing countries, for industrial, residential and productive land. Factories, which emit harmful gases to the air and toxic wastes to water source, have been opened in every parts of the world to produce various kinds of food, drinks, clothes, etc. This has put unprecedented strains on our finely balanced ecosystem.

In order to solve the problem, both government and individuals should take actions immediately. Firstly, government should put forward a stricter regulation to control the overpopulation issue. Secondly, individuals should adopt a more eco-friendly consumption habits. For example, people should buy biodegradable packaged products, support organic food or avoid overusing plastic bags. Another feasible action is that all industrial and domestic wastes like paper or glass should be sorted out and recycled. By taking all these actions, our living environment would become better and greener.

In conclusion, overpopulation has created undesirable effects on the natural environment. It is the responsibility of both government and people living on the planet to protect it before it is too late.

topic: Sports which depend on violence for their entertainment, such as boxing and wrestling, have no place in a civilized society and should be banned. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
With the pressures and bustles in modern life, sport is considered as one of the best form of entertainments. In recent years, the popularity of sports containing violent factors has led to the heated controversy over the question whether they should be banned or not. Many people hold a strong view suggesting that combat sports cannot be existed in a civilized society. However, from my point of view, it should be made illegal due to the reasons presented in this essay.

To begin with, in a well-organized and developed society, people have the rights to decide which sports are suitable to practice and entertain. In other words, the prohibition can be used to illustrate for fossilizing human civilization to the past and restricting the development of human's rights. Furthermore, if boxing and wrestling are not allowed to play, law systems generate the unfairness between them with other sports which also cause some serious injuries or even death such as extreme sports and contact sports.

Similarly, combat sports benefit society in many ways. In specific, it is a suitable method for improving health's communities when people do exercise reasonably. Moreover, people can use it to defend themselves in may dangerous situations. Whilst women, for example, use it to against criminal rapes, men can protect themselves in a society where violence is increasing considerably. Last but not least, by imposing taxes on sport entertainment industry, government can get money for social budget, using for charity and succour purposes, or improving the living condition of residents.

All in all, the is no denying that fighting sports have advantages for both individuals and socities. Therefore, I would like to emphasize and reiterate that instead of banning them, we should permit them in controllable scales.

topic: Even in today's advanced era, many people believe that bicycles are the best way to commute from one place to another. Ċ How far do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In this day and age, technology has made transportation more efficient and convenient. While many individuals argue that bicycles are still the best mode of commuting, others disagree. In my opinion, I strongly concur with the former view, as cycles are the most efficient way of travelling because of its convenience, health benefits and environment-friendly. In this essay, the aforementioned view shall be elaborated further.

Firstly, the pollution levels are rising at an unprecedented rate these days, and it is high time that something should be done about it. Bicycles are the most accessible form of transportation because of its size and weight as it is easier to carry and get through narrow spaces. Secondly, travelling by cycles promote a healthier lifestyle. For instance, it often reported that people nowadays have little or no physical activities in their lives eventually leading to obesity and other health-related issues. As a result, cycling serves as a form of physical activity that keeps an individual fit and active.

Furthermore, another benefit of cycling is that it is ecological-friendly because it does not have any fuel emission or cause traffic congestion. For instance, In Japan, the government has installed special lane and parking facilities to encourage and motivate people to use cycle. Consequently, the traffic, air and noise pollution have plummeted drastically in such regions.

To summarize, had it not been the rise of pollution and health problems, bicycles would not have been considered as the ideal mode of transportation. Therefore, I completely agree with the statement that cycles are the most ideal way for commuting.

topic: Question: Many employers are now offering their employees the option to work from home. As a result, employee will have much flexible working hours in the future. Is this a positive or negative develpoment? work from home - the great innovation
essay:
Nowadays employees are provided option to work at home instead of in office. It is believed that employees' working hours will be more flexible in the future. The advantage of working at home that will be discussed in this essay is that, it makes employees more convenient to work at home. The disadvantage, however, is that employees are not able to join face-to-face discussion.

Work at home can bring a lot of convenience to employess because they can accompany their family member while working, especially for those who have to take care of their small children. It can also improve relationship between family members. For instance, parent can prepare breakfast for their children before sending them to school and spend time with them after school.

Hoewever, there is also disadvantage when employees working at home. Sometimes there will be soome urgent meetings that all employees must present and discuss about it. Although the employees who works at home can join the discussion through phone or Skype, it is still problematic in communication when network connection is poor. This may result in missunderstanding and some urgent problem could not be solved immediately. For example, other employees might not hear clearly what the other talking about when there is transmission delay.

Notwithstanding the possible occurence of misunderstanding, in my opinion, it is still good to allow employee to work at home because the relationship between family member are more valuable in compare to the missunderstandiing that might occur during a discussion.

In conclusion, it is clear that an option to work from home can benefits employees, including flexible working hours and also strong bond between family member. For those who have bad network connection at ome should find solution to solve their problem in order to work at home.

pro_keypoints: Remote work increases employee autonomy and trust in managing their responsibilities.
Flexible hours improve work-life balance and reduce commuting-related stress.
Employers can boost productivity by allowing personalized work schedules.
Work-from-home models contribute to environmental sustainability by reducing transportation emissions.
Geographic flexibility enables access to a broader, more diverse talent pool.
Reduced office overhead lowers operational costs for businesses.
con_keypoints: Remote work may blur boundaries between personal and professional life.
Lack of in-person interaction can weaken team cohesion and company culture.
Not all employees have equal access to suitable home work environments.
Monitoring performance becomes more challenging in a distributed workforce.
Some roles inherently require physical presence and cannot be remote.
Reduced face time may slow career advancement for remote workers.
